input_equivalence_lay_TN.interpretation: Annual source columns and the topology match the package data exactly (InvNrmRain/ForestFraction to float precision). The catchment scalars do not: the correlation between Length.csv and the built-in NrmLengthKm is -0.04, so the GREENeR_data length file is not the source of the built-in column at all; the built-in Shreve column holds classic Shreve magnitudes rather than the topological levels that read_NSdata's shreve() generates; and the built-in LakeFrRet values differ from the Kronvang formula applied to the CSV lake properties by up to 0.006. read_NSdata applied to these CSVs - in R or in this port - cannot reproduce those three columns; the difference is data provenance inside the GREENeR repositories, not a port discrepancy.

lay_obs_agreement.note: Parameters are the vignette doc example, not calibrated; agreement is a plausibility check, not a fit claim.
